name: Austin Animal Services Volunteer Program (teens)
org: City of Austin Animal Services
what_you_do: Help dogs and cats find homes. You greet visitors, walk and play with dogs, and help cats and kittens get used to people. You also help at outreach events.
deadline_text: No deadline. Apply any time.

name: City of Austin High School Summer Internship Programs
org: City of Austin, Austin Economic Development (Youth Initiatives)
what_you_do: Six-week paid summer internships in City departments and partner sites. One application covers five tracks: Emerging Leaders, Get Ready (STEAM), Automotive/Entrepreneurial, Aviation Department, and the Austin Convention Center (on hold).
grades: Rising sophomore, junior or senior, or current senior
deadline_text: 2026 application ran Jan 28 to Feb 28, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Color Squad teen mural program
org: Creative Action
what_you_do: Join a group of teen artists who plan and paint big murals around Austin. Each year the group picks a topic in the town to work on. Past murals were made with Cap Metro and other groups.
deadline_text: No dates on the page. Email to ask when the next group starts.

name: Works In Progress (WIP) Paid Arts Internship
org: Dougherty Arts Center, City of Austin Arts, Culture, Music and Entertainment Department
what_you_do: Paid 8 week arts internship in person at the Dougherty Arts Center and the Zilker Hillside Theater. The page calls it a program for high school students.
deadline_text: 2026 applications are closed. 2027 dates are not posted. Join the Dougherty Arts Center mailing list for updates.

name: Austin Fire Explorers Post 370
org: Austin Fire Department with Capitol Area Council, Scouting America
what_you_do: Learn how to fight fires, do rescues and give first aid, taught by Austin firefighters. You get real gear and train where they train. Teams compete in fire games each year.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Fill out the interest card to get updates.

name: Austin Habitat for Humanity Youth Volunteering
org: Austin Habitat for Humanity
what_you_do: Teens help build homes and help the families who will live in them. Ages 16 and 17 can do new home building. Younger teens do jobs like painting flower boxes, building tables or tutoring the kids of these families.
deadline_text: No deadline. Check the volunteer calendar for dates.

name: Austin Humane Society Teen Volunteer
org: Austin Humane Society
what_you_do: Help care for animals, mostly by getting cats and dogs used to people. You also help with outreach projects that work to end pet homelessness in Central Texas.
deadline_text: No deadline. Register any time.

name: Austin ISD Summer Internship Program
org: Austin ISD with Austin Ed Fund and the Austin Chamber of Commerce
what_you_do: Work at a business or community partner for 6 weeks, about 20 hours a week. Students are placed by their interests and what is open.
deadline_text: The 2026 interest form closed Feb 6, 2026. A banner on the page says 2027 details are coming and the student form opens in December (year not stated, so confirm).

name: Teen Library Fellowship
org: Austin Public Library with the Austin Library Foundation
what_you_do: Paid fellows meet each month. They plan community action projects. Projects include a teen magazine, workshops, open mics and a podcast. Fellows also help host library programs for teens.
deadline_text: Foundation page: the next cohort application opens in May 2027. The 2026-27 application ran May 1-31, 2026.

name: Youth Volunteer Program
org: Austin Public Library
what_you_do: Help library staff with checkout and programs. You help set up and take down programs. You re-shelve books and run teen clubs. You do light clean-up. You usually work with the youth librarians.
deadline_text: Windows each year: fall Jul 1-31, spring Dec 1-31, summer Mar 1-31. The fall window has closed; the next one is spring, Dec 1-31 (the page gives these windows without a year).

name: Caminos Teen Leadership Program
org: Emma S. Barrientos Mexican American Cultural Center (City of Austin)
what_you_do: This is a paid creative arts internship. Teens make murals, publications, films and events with local artists. Teens also plan programs for other teens. You learn about Latin American and Indigenous cultures.
deadline_text: Applications for the Class of 2027 are closed. The next round (Class of 2028) is due in Spring 2027, announced on Instagram @atxcaminos.

name: Lifeguard training and hiring
org: Austin Parks and Recreation Department, Aquatic Division
what_you_do: You train as a certified lifeguard. You work at City of Austin pools and aquatic facilities. New and returning guards fill out an application. They also do hiring paperwork before they sign up for training.
deadline_text: Spring 2026 hiring open hours were Mar 31, Apr 16 and Apr 28 (4 to 8 p.m.) at 2818 San Gabriel St. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Roving Leaders teen program
org: Austin Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Build life and leadership skills and talk about hard topics teens face every day. Learn problem solving and how your habits connect to where you live. Join fun, learning and culture activities.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 camp ran June 8 to August 7, 2026, and now shows as unavailable. 2027 dates are not posted. The listing says late additions are always welcome.

name: Totally Cool Totally Art (TCTA) free teen art classes
org: Austin Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Make art after school with real artists at a city rec center. You can try painting and drawing, or metals and mixed media. Other sessions are digital art and cartoons, or foam sculpture and games.
deadline_text: 2026 to 2027 classes are listed now. Montopolis sign up opened October 1, 2026. No end date is posted.

name: SAFE Expect Respect Summer Youth Leadership Academy
org: The SAFE Alliance
what_you_do: A paid five-week summer job at SAFE. You get job and leader training. You work on real projects that teach teens about healthy dating and how to stop bullying and abuse.
deadline_text: Registration goes through Travis County's Summer Youth Employment Program, which opens Summer 2027 applications in January 2027 (exact date not posted).

name: Teen Summer Volunteer Program, St. David's Medical Center
org: St. David's HealthCare, St. David's Medical Center
what_you_do: Help patients and visitors find their way. You also help with wheelchair rides at discharge, restock nurses' stations and keep patients company. Top needs include the gift shop, discharge lounge and info desks.
deadline_text: The page says applications open March 15 and close April 15 at 11:59 pm, once a year. The year is not stated.

name: Teen Summer Volunteer Program, St. David's North Austin Medical Center
org: St. David's HealthCare, North Austin Medical Center
what_you_do: Volunteer at a hospital for the summer. After you apply, you send more paperwork. If you are picked, you interview, finish screenings and go to orientation.
deadline_text: The page says applications run March 1 to March 31 and late materials are not accepted. The year is not stated.

name: VolunTeen Program
org: Thinkery Austin (children's museum)
what_you_do: Teens do 60 hours of training, then give 40 hours of service at the museum. Thinkery says 208 VolunTeens served 8,880 hours in its last reported year.
deadline_text: Dates and application window are not stated on the program page.

name: Urban Roots High School Leadership Programs
org: Urban Roots
what_you_do: The page describes paid youth internships for teens. It does not say what the work involves. Free elementary day camps and a free middle school Food Lab are also listed, but those are not for high schoolers.
deadline_text: Applications are closed. The page says to watch for future opportunities. No dates are posted.

name: Youth Career Services
org: Workforce Solutions Capital Area
what_you_do: Work readiness and life skills training, personal guidance, work experience and help earning a credential for low income youth. In school students are served through Climb the Ladder CTX.
deadline_text: No deadline listed on the Youth Services page, and it does not say when you can start.

name: Austin Youth Council
org: City of Austin Economic Development (Youth Initiatives)
what_you_do: Meet monthly, hear from City staff, plan actions on community issues and talk with City Council members. Members learn Robert's Rules of Order. They also go to monthly service events.
deadline_text: Applications are closed. The page says 2027 to 2028 applications are expected to open in Spring 2027.

name: Austin Youth Development (AYD)
org: Austin Public Health, City of Austin
what_you_do: A City of Austin youth program for ages 17 to 22. The page says it offers paid work with the City, mentoring and career planning. The goal is to help youth earn a livable wage.
deadline_text: No application dates are listed.

name: Youth Forest Council
org: City of Austin, Austin Climate Action and Resilience (Urban Forest Program)
what_you_do: This is a yearlong paid internship. It is with the City's Urban Forest Program. You help plan community events. You design education materials about trees. You represent the program in your neighborhood.
deadline_text: Applications for the 2026-27 cohort were due March 15, 2026. The page says applications open again in January 2027.

name: Volunteer program
org: Bullock Texas State History Museum
what_you_do: You welcome visitors. Roles include podium attendant and gallery roamer. Others are school group volunteer and programs and events helper. This is at the state history museum.
deadline_text: The page says applications for the volunteer program are open. No deadline is stated.

name: Junior volunteer program at Del Sol Medical Center
org: Del Sol Medical Center (HCA Healthcare)
what_you_do: Volunteer at the hospital in one of several positions. The program page does not list the tasks.
deadline_text: Junior volunteer applications are accepted from March 15 through May 1 each year. Expect it to reopen around March 15, 2027.

name: Teen volunteer program at El Paso Animal Services
org: El Paso Animal Services (City of El Paso)
what_you_do: Walk dogs, give enrichment, help with animal care, and greet visitors at the city shelter. The program page does not describe the Cats at the Zoo program.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the program page. Apply any time.

name: El Paso Health Youth Volunteer Program (EPHY)
org: El Paso Health
what_you_do: Help with community health projects and learn how the local health care system works. The program also lets youth speak up about local health policy.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the program page.

name: El Paso Public Library volunteer program
org: El Paso Public Library
what_you_do: Volunteer at the public library. The program page does not list the tasks. Apply through the link on the program page first.
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the program page.

name: NextForce youth program
org: Workforce Solutions Borderplex
what_you_do: Get free career planning, workshops, school support and work experience. Work experience can be paid or unpaid.
deadline_text: No deadline is stated on the program page. Contact NextForce to ask about starting.

name: High School Volunteers, St. David's Georgetown Hospital
org: St. David's HealthCare, Georgetown Hospital
what_you_do: Volunteer in hospital departments for 3 to 4 hours a week during the summer program (up to 8 weeks). A few students are also accepted during the year.
deadline_text: Summer session dates and deadlines are not listed on the page checked.

name: Job Corps: Gary Job Corps Center (San Marcos)
org: U.S. Department of Labor Job Corps
what_you_do: Free live-on-campus career training. Programs listed include Advanced Cement Masonry (Pre-Apprentice), Advanced Electrical (Overhead Line Construction) and Advanced Transportation Service Worker.
deadline_text: Open enrollment: you can start the application at any time.

name: Teen Tutor and Session Lead Volunteers
org: OneInMath
city: Libraries in Texas and Pennsylvania (ask which one has a chapter)
what_you_do: Tutor 4 to 5 kindergarten to 3rd grade students in math using the OneInMath lessons. The program is run with libraries. You earn volunteer hours.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Register to volunteer on the site.

name: Round Rock Public Library Teen Advisory Board
org: Round Rock Public Library
what_you_do: Help the teen librarian plan teen programs, pick new books and promote events. Members volunteer at library programs at least 3 times a year. They earn community service hours.
deadline_text: The page says no positions are open now. An application form is posted when positions open. No dates are given.

name: Teen Summer Reading Challenge Volunteer, Round Rock Library
org: Round Rock Public Library
what_you_do: Work one or two shifts a week to help with the library's Summer Reading Challenge. Each shift is 2 to 2.5 hours. It runs in June and July.
deadline_text: 2026 registration is closed. The page also says to check back April 2 (year not stated), so confirm with the teen librarian.

name: Round Rock Lifeguard Training and Seasonal Aquatics Jobs
org: City of Round Rock Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Take a lifeguard class, then work as a lifeguard at city pools. The city also hires pool attendants, swim teachers and cashiers. There is a path from pool attendant to lifeguard.
deadline_text: No application deadline is listed. The 2026 classes ran Mar 16 to May 30, 2026. The program page links a 2027 class flyer.

name: Texas 4-H
org: Texas 4-H, Texas A&M AgriLife Extension
what_you_do: Join a county 4-H club and pick at least one project. Take part in club meetings, events and contests. The program offers hands-on leadership, community service and career discovery.
deadline_text: Enroll by October 31 for the lower fee ($25). After that the fee is $30 until the end of the 4-H year. Memberships reset every August 15.

name: Texas 4-H Ambassador Teams
org: Texas 4-H, Texas A&M AgriLife Extension
what_you_do: High school 4-H members can join a state ambassador team. There are teams for livestock, horses, poultry, water, science, photos, fashion and room design, shooting sports, and healthy living.
deadline_text: Each team posts its own dates. Examples on the page: Fashion and Interior Design March 1 to 31, 2026. STEM July 1 to 31. Shooting Sports opens June 1. Photography opens in spring.

name: Texas 4-H Council
org: Texas 4-H, Texas A&M AgriLife Extension
what_you_do: Speak for the Texas 4-H program across the state. Work with Extension staff to plan and run events. Seats go to district delegates from the twelve AgriLife Extension districts. There are also six At-Large Delegates.
deadline_text: 2026 Council training was July 27 to 30, 2026 in College Station. Ask your District 4-H Specialist for the district application deadline. The page does not list an At-Large deadline.

name: Texas Boys State
org: The American Legion, Department of Texas
what_you_do: Spend a week running a pretend city, county and state government. You join one of two practice political parties, run for office, hear speakers and debate.
grades: Just finished 11th grade, with at least one semester of high school left
deadline_text: 2027 dates and the application deadline are not posted on the program pages. The 2026 session ran June 7 to 12, 2026. The site shows an Applications Now Open banner, but it posts no deadline or 2027 dates, so ask your school and local Post.

name: American Legion Auxiliary Texas Bluebonnet Girls State
org: American Legion Auxiliary, Department of Texas
what_you_do: Spend a week at Texas Lutheran University in a pretend 51st state. You set up your own city, county and state governments and take a trip to the State Capitol.
grades: Junior year (11th grade) of high school
deadline_text: 2027 dates are not posted. In 2026, units could reserve spots Feb 1 to May 1 and schools Feb 15 to May 1. The page says spots fill fast, so act quickly.

name: Texas Brigades Camps (Cadet)
org: Texas Brigades
city: Camps across Texas (Rising Star, La Pryor, McCoy, Freer, Santa Anna, Garwood, Anahuac)
what_you_do: Spend five days at a wildlife and land stewardship leadership camp. Past camps covered bobwhite quail, deer, bass, ranching, waterfowl and coastal wildlife.
deadline_text: 2027 applications open Nov 1, 2026 and close March 15, 2027. The 2026 camps ran June 7 to Aug 1, 2026.

name: Texas ChalleNGe Academy
org: Texas Military Department (Texas National Guard)
what_you_do: Live on the Eagle Lake campus in a free residential program for teens who are disengaged from school. After the on-campus phase there is a follow-up phase with a mentor.
deadline_text: Recruitment is open now for the January 2027 cohort. Classes start in January and July. The application cutoff is normally no later than 30 days before class starts (so about early December 2026 for January 2027).

name: Summer Junior Volunteer Program (North Austin)
org: Texas Children's Hospital North Austin
what_you_do: This is four weeks of full-day volunteering at a children's hospital. You take three to four assignments a day. Examples are a tea cart, craft cart, library, physical therapy and supply chain. You also get a lunch and learn.
grades: Enrolled in high school for the following school year
deadline_text: The 2026 application opened Monday Feb 9 and closed Friday Feb 13, 2026 at 5:00 p.m. 2027 dates are not posted.

name: Texas DECA (high school)
org: Texas DECA, chartered association of DECA Inc.
what_you_do: Join your school's DECA chapter to build business and marketing skills. Take part in DECA programs and contests. Texas DECA runs a yearly state career development conference.
deadline_text: Membership deadlines come from your chapter advisor. The 2027 state conference is Feb 25 to 27, 2027 at the George R. Brown Convention Center in Houston.

name: Texas Envirothon
org: Environmental Institute of Houston, University of Houston-Clear Lake
city: Statewide, TX (state event in Nacogdoches in 2026)
what_you_do: Teams of five high school students study soils, water life, wildlife, forestry and a current issue. They take field tests and give an oral presentation at the state contest.
deadline_text: 2026 state event: March 28 to 30, 2026 in Nacogdoches. Page says registration opens in 2026 with the deadline to be announced.

name: Texas FFA Association
org: Texas FFA Association
what_you_do: Take an agricultural science class at school and join your local FFA chapter. FFA is a student-led leadership group. Members earn degrees and can join contests, speaking events and leadership programs.
grades: Agricultural science classes start no earlier than 7th grade. Junior FFA starts at 3rd grade.
deadline_text: No application deadline. You join through your school's agriculture program.

name: Texas HOSA Future Health Professionals
org: Texas HOSA
what_you_do: Join a HOSA chapter at your school to explore health careers. Texas HOSA runs a state leadership conference each year. Membership comes through school chapters.
grades: Middle school grades 6 to 8, and high school (secondary) students
deadline_text: No membership deadlines or conference dates are on the program pages. Ask your advisor for dates.

name: Texas State Parks Volunteer Program
org: Texas Parks and Wildlife Department
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Texas state park. Jobs include special events, gift shop and office help, trail and grounds work, plant restoration, and leading tours and nature programs.
deadline_text: Apply any time. Openings are listed in the online portal.

name: REACT @ TAMU Chemistry (summer research training)
org: Texas A&M University, Department of Chemistry
what_you_do: Spend part of the summer on campus in a hands-on chemistry research training program. Up to 20 students learn lab skills, see research demos and prepare for chemistry research in high school.
grades: High school students (the 2026 page says as of Fall 2026)
deadline_text: The 2027 application opens Jan 19, 2027. No closing date is posted. In 2026, students were notified April 24, 2026.

name: Summer Earn and Learn (SEAL) for students with disabilities
org: Texas Workforce Commission, Vocational Rehabilitation, with local workforce boards
what_you_do: Get a paid summer job placement of at least five weeks. You earn a paycheck while learning new skills and gaining work experience.
deadline_text: No dates for summer 2027 are posted on the program pages. It is a summer program. Ask your local office in the fall or winter.

name: Civil Air Patrol Cadet Program, Texas Wing
org: Civil Air Patrol, Texas Wing
what_you_do: Join a local squadron to learn leadership, aerospace and STEM, fitness and character. Cadets can go to summer and winter encampments. They can take part in real Civil Air Patrol missions.
deadline_text: Join any time. Attend three squadron meetings first.

name: Texas Youth Range Workshop
org: Texas Section, Society for Range Management
what_you_do: High school students spend a week at the Texas Tech University Center in Junction. They learn about grassland, plants, soil and wildlife on Texas ranches.
deadline_text: 2026 workshop was June 21 to 26, 2026. The 2026 deadline and 2027 dates were not posted on the program page.

name: Summer Youth Employment Program (SYEP)
org: Travis County Health and Human Services with Austin Public Health
what_you_do: You get paid summer work experience at a host site. There are more than 80 host sites. They are businesses, nonprofits and government offices. You first complete a required job readiness training.
deadline_text: Summer 2026 applications are closed. The county says applications for Summer 2027 open in January 2027 (exact date not posted). Fill out the 2027 interest form to be told when they open.

grades: Current or rising high school student
name: Summer Medical Camp
org: Texas Tech University Health Sciences Center El Paso, Foster School of Medicine
what_you_do: Meet health care workers. Go on field trips. Try a mock crime scene. Do a reality store task about the cost of life. Learn about college and money for school.
deadline_text: The 2026 camps ran June 8 to 18 and June 22 to July 2. Dates for the next camp will be announced closer to next summer.

grades: Rising sophomore, junior or senior (preference for rising juniors and seniors)
name: High School Summer Research Academy (HSRA)
org: College of Natural Sciences, The University of Texas at Austin
what_you_do: Join a UT College of Natural Sciences lab for five weeks, about 15 to 25 hours a week. Present a poster at the closing symposium and earn UT extension course credit.
deadline_text: The 2027 application opens mid January 2027. Deadline is listed as March 2027 (no day). Late applications may be accepted on a limited basis.

name: Summer Discovery at UT Austin
org: The University of Texas at Austin Office of Admissions with Summer Discovery
what_you_do: Take college style, non credit courses or a one subject academy on the UT campus. Classes meet Monday to Thursday. You can live in a campus dorm or commute.
deadline_text: 2026 sessions were June 14 to 26 and June 28 to July 17. 2027 dates and deadlines are not posted on the program pages.

name: Longhorn Engineering Summer Camp (LESC)
org: Cockrell School of Engineering, The University of Texas at Austin
what_you_do: This is a four-day camp for rising 8th and 9th graders. You hear talks from UT faculty and students. Then you do hands-on activities. The activities show how engineering connects to art, sports, medicine and sustainability.
deadline_text: Registration for 2026 closed March 12, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. 2027 dates are not posted.

grades: Current Texas high school sophomores and juniors
name: DYNAMC (Discover Yourself In Accounting Majors and Careers)
org: McCombs School of Business, The University of Texas at Austin
what_you_do: Learn about jobs you can get with an accounting degree. There are sessions, networking and mentoring. Sponsored by Ernst & Young Global Limited.
deadline_text: The page says applications are closed now. It lists a 2027 application deadline of Feb 1, 2027 (supplemental materials Feb 8, 2027) and does not state an opening date. Confirm with McCombs.

grades: Current Texas high school sophomores and juniors
name: McCombs Future Executive Academy (MFEA)
org: McCombs School of Business, The University of Texas at Austin
what_you_do: Hands-on workshops in many business fields. You hear faculty and keynote speakers. You also meet people in business and join case contests.
deadline_text: The page says applications are closed now. It lists a 2027 application deadline of Feb 1, 2027 (supplemental materials Feb 8, 2027) and does not state an opening date. Confirm with McCombs.

name: Subiendo: The Academy for Rising Leaders
org: McCombs School of Business, The University of Texas at Austin
what_you_do: A week on campus to build leadership. You meet faculty and speakers and get mentoring from UT student leaders. You also meet new people.
deadline_text: The page says applications are closed now. It lists a 2027 application deadline of Feb 1, 2027 (supplemental materials Feb 8, 2027) and does not state an opening date. Confirm with McCombs.

name: UTEP Mining Engineering Summer Camp
org: Miguel A. Loya College of Engineering, UTEP
what_you_do: Tour a real foundry and a working mine. Try lab demos in metals and rocks. Stay in UTEP dorms.
deadline_text: The 2026 camps ran June 21 to 23, June 24 to 26 and June 28 to 30. Use the Get Notified button on the program page for future camps.

name: UTEP Upward Bound
org: University of Texas at El Paso
what_you_do: Get free classes to get ready for college. Get leadership training and ways to help the community all year. Students stay in the program until they finish high school and their first summer at UTEP.
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page. Email or call to ask about selection.

name: Summer Youth Volunteer Program at VA El Paso
org: VA El Paso Healthcare System
what_you_do: Serve Veterans and get real health care experience at the VA during the summer.
deadline_text: Applications open in May and spots fill up quickly. Expect it to reopen in May 2027.
